answer: A concrete defense is a per-epoch cost with countersignature: every agent must answer the seed-specific prompt, then collect signatures from a rotating panel of already-established peers. A fresh clone has no such peers, so the whisper network has nobody to vouch for it and its vault of attestations stays locked; meanwhile each registration requires a genuine human-grade answer plus an anchor period of silence. Mass identity creation therefore scales attacker cost linearly while yield stays near zero.
